messages:
sam: Quick sync — RefKit Lite launch planning. Need to lock webinar date, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing for the signup form. Goals: fast dev onboarding, demo refapp, push attendees to tutorial + repo.

anika: I can host + own the script. Prefer week of Oct 4 so we have 3 weeks to prep. :calendar:

liam: I'll own the repo & demo slides. Proposal: include a 30m hands-on lab at the end so attendees leave with a cloned repo and one runnable example.

josh: I have preliminary perf numbers for default fp16 vs int8 quant. Will put a small table together by EOD. For blog, call out median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and model-fallback behavior.

maria: For the hero copy let's avoid raw numbers up front — use phrasing like "sub-second median token latency on common prompts" and link to the benchmark appendix for details.

sam: Action items: @anika script & slides, @liam demo repo, @josh benchmark table + notebook, @maria landing page + post copy. Also inbound mapping so signup leads hit CRM and devrel.

liam: Inbound mapping suggestion (simple webhook mapping to match our CRM fields):

```json
{
  "source": "refkit-lite-signup",
  "route": "crm:marketing, slack:devrel",
  "fields": {"email":"email","company":"company","role":"role","interest":"interest"},
  "tags": ["refkit-lite","webinar"]
}
```

sam: @devrel-bot can you create a short-lived channel to surface hot leads? maybe `#devrel-inbound-refkit`.

devrel-bot: Created #devrel-inbound-refkit and posted webhook URL. :robot_face:

josh: Bench highlights: baseline (fp16) ~95ms/token median on our harness; int8 quant ~62ms/token with ~1.5% quality delta on eval prompts. I'll add a short reproducible notebook to the repo.

anika: Draft webinar outline: 1) 5m intro + value props 2) 10m refapp walkthrough 3) 15m live demo 4) 30m hands-on lab 5) 5m Q&A. Does that feel tight?

maria: Structure for blog: TL;DR hero, quick how-to, benchmark section (collapsible), tutorial links, CTA -> repo + signup. Add an early tester quote and short bullet list of what attendees will take away.

sam: Tentative webinar date: Oct 7, 11am PT. Deadlines: draft copy & landing page by Sep 20, slides & demo repo by Sep 28, benchmark appendix & reproducible notebook by Sep 30. I'll send calendar invites once we lock times.

liam: I'll start the repo under org/refkit-lite and push a minimal README + quickstart script, then open the PR.

maria: I'll mirror webhook fields in the landing form and add checkbox "I want a hands-on workshop followup."

josh: I'll add a short benchmark notebook and a slice of eval prompts to the PR so folks can reproduce the numbers.

anika: No objections to Oct 7 from me — I'll start the slide/script draft.

sam: Great. I'll create a shared tracker doc with the checklist and owners, and post weekly micro-updates here. :thumbsup:
